name: workflow-manager
description: Quality-first, context-efficient, efficiency-biased workflow management with adaptive routing, lossless output guidance, compaction recovery, and dynamic subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Protect reasoning quality while managing context and agents.
interface.longDescription: Guides multi-step work without omitting required reasoning, evidence, correction, or verification; preserves oversized tool results for model reasoning; resumes acceptance state across compaction; and dynamically delegates positive-utility independent lanes.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-manager: keep only relevant stages while preserving required reasoning, evidence, correction, and verification.
Correctness and acceptance evidence outrank context savings; checkpoint before compaction and remove only redundancy.
For complex work, optimize expected wall-clock time; delegate positive-utility owned lanes and serialize only real conflicts.
